words.enDefinition: Money an individual has saved

examples.en: My personal savings grew a little during the months I worked at the library.
examples.zh: 我在图书馆工作的那几个月里，「个人积蓄」增加了一些。

examples.en: I keep my personal savings separate from the money my flatmates send for bills.
examples.zh: 我把「个人积蓄」和室友转给我缴账单的钱分开存放。

words.enDefinition: To reserve money for a later purpose

examples.en: I set money aside whenever I get paid for a weekend shift at the café.
examples.zh: 每次收到咖啡店周末班的工资，我都会「留出一笔钱」。

examples.en: Can we set money aside for the train tickets before we book the hotel?
examples.zh: 我们能在订酒店前先为火车票「留出一笔钱」吗？

collocations: set money aside for a trip

words.enDefinition: To save money for future unexpected needs

examples.en: My grandmother used to say she liked to save for a rainy day.
examples.zh: 我奶奶以前常说，她喜欢「存钱以备不时之需」。

examples.en: Since my shifts vary, I try to save for a rainy day when work is steady.
examples.zh: 因为我的班次不固定，所以工作稳定时我会尽量「存钱以备不时之需」。

collocations: try to save for a rainy day
learn to save for a rainy day
start to save for a rainy day

words.enDefinition: A planned result for saving money

examples.en: My first savings goal was enough for a train ticket home at Christmas.
examples.zh: 我的第一个「储蓄目标」是存够钱买一张圣诞节回家的火车票。

examples.en: The app lets me give each savings goal a different name and photo.
examples.zh: 这个应用可以让我给每个「储蓄目标」设置不同的名称和照片。

words.enDefinition: The total amount someone aims to save

examples.en: I entered a target amount before the app drew a progress bar for my trip.
examples.zh: 我先输入「目标金额」，应用才为这趟旅行生成了进度条。

examples.en: The target amount includes the deposit for the course and the cost of the textbooks.
examples.zh: 这个「目标金额」包括课程订金和课本费用。

words.enDefinition: The planned date for reaching a goal

examples.en: I moved the target date to June when I found out my placement starts later.
examples.zh: 得知实习开始得更晚后，我把「目标日期」改到了六月。

examples.en: The savings tool asks for a target date after you name the goal.
examples.zh: 给目标命名后，储蓄工具会要求输入「目标日期」。

words.enDefinition: A tool for tracking money saved over time

examples.en: I made a savings tracker in a spreadsheet for my summer language course.
examples.zh: 我在电子表格里做了一个「储蓄进度记录工具」，用来记录暑期语言课程的存款。

examples.en: The savings tracker shows how much my sister and I have put toward the trip.
examples.zh: 这个「储蓄进度记录工具」显示了我和姐姐为这趟旅行一共存了多少钱。

words.enDefinition: How far someone has advanced toward saving a target

examples.en: I check my savings progress at the end of each month after payday.
examples.zh: 我每个月月底发薪后都会查看自己的「储蓄进度」。

examples.en: The bar makes my savings progress easier to see without opening each individual transaction.
examples.zh: 有了进度条，我不用打开每一笔交易也能看清「储蓄进度」。

words.enDefinition: The amount still needed to reach a savings target

examples.en: My spreadsheet shows a savings gap of eighty euros for the spring trip.
examples.zh: 我的电子表格显示，为春游准备的钱还有八十欧元的「储蓄差额」。

examples.en: The savings gap got smaller after I added my wages from the extra shift.
examples.zh: 把加班报酬存进去以后，「储蓄差额」变小了。

words.enDefinition: To save the full amount planned

examples.en: I finally managed to reach a savings goal I had set before starting college.
examples.zh: 我终于「实现了一个储蓄目标」，那是我上大学前定下的。

examples.en: It felt good to reach a savings goal before booking the train home.
examples.zh: 在订回家的火车票前就能「实现储蓄目标」，感觉很好。

collocations: help someone reach a savings goal
work to reach a savings goal

words.enDefinition: To stop putting money away for a period

examples.en: I had to pause saving for the laptop when my shifts were cut.
examples.zh: 我的班次减少后，只好「暂时停止为买笔记本电脑存钱」。

examples.en: Did you pause saving for the trip while you were between part-time jobs?
examples.zh: 你换兼职的那段时间有「暂时停止为旅行存钱」吗？

words.enDefinition: To start setting aside money again

examples.en: I hope to resume saving for the course when the new term starts.
examples.zh: 我希望新学期开始时能「重新开始为课程存钱」。

examples.en: After the move, Mia was able to resume saving for a new laptop.
examples.zh: 搬家后，米娅又能「重新开始为买新笔记本电脑存钱」了。

words.enDefinition: Money set aside automatically under a saved instruction

examples.en: The app offers automatic savings for users who want regular transfers to a separate balance.
examples.zh: 该应用为想定期把钱转到独立余额中的用户提供「自动储蓄」功能。

examples.en: I turned off automatic savings while I was waiting for my first paycheck.
examples.zh: 等第一笔工资到账时，我关闭了「自动储蓄」。

words.enDefinition: A repeated transfer of money into savings

examples.en: My recurring savings transfer appears on the statement on the fifth of each month.
examples.zh: 我的「定期储蓄转账」在每月五日出现在账单上。

examples.en: Can I change the date of a recurring savings transfer without cancelling it first?
examples.zh: 我能在不先取消「定期储蓄转账」的情况下更改日期吗？

words.enDefinition: Money added to a savings goal once

examples.en: I made a one-off contribution to my travel fund with the money from tutoring.
examples.zh: 我把辅导课赚的钱「一次性存进」了旅行基金。

examples.en: The one-off contribution showed up separately from my usual monthly transfer on the statement.
examples.zh: 这笔「一次性存款」在账单上和我平常的月度转账分开显示。

collocations: a one-off contribution of fifty dollars

words.enDefinition: An amount of money added to savings

examples.en: The bank lists each savings contribution beside the date it reached my account.
examples.zh: 银行在每笔「存入储蓄的钱」旁边都标明了到账日期。

examples.en: My regular savings contribution was smaller in July because I worked fewer shifts.
examples.zh: 我七月的班次少了，所以那个月「定期存入储蓄的钱」也少了。

words.enDefinition: To set aside the same amount each time

examples.en: I used to save a fixed amount from every paycheck during my summer job.
examples.zh: 暑期打工时，我以前每次发工资都会「存下固定金额」。

examples.en: The app lets me save a fixed amount on the same day each month.
examples.zh: 这个应用可以让我每个月在同一天「存下固定金额」。

collocations: save a fixed amount each week
save a fixed amount per paycheck
choose to save a fixed amount

words.expression: save a little at a time
words.lemma: save a little at a time
words.enDefinition: To build savings through small amounts
acceptedEnVariants: save a little at a time

examples.en: I had to save a little at a time for my first used bike.
examples.zh: 为了买第一辆二手自行车，我只能「一点一点地存钱」。

examples.en: We could only save a little at a time while we were on placement.
examples.zh: 我们实习期间只能「一点一点地存钱」。

collocations: start to save a little at a time
learn to save a little at a time
manage to save a little at a time

words.enDefinition: To put money aside on a regular basis

examples.en: I found it easier to save regularly once my work schedule stayed the same.
examples.zh: 工作时间固定下来后，我发现「定期存钱」更容易了。

examples.en: My brother started to save regularly during his first year at the university.
examples.zh: 我弟弟在大学一年级时开始「定期存钱」。

collocations: find it hard to save regularly

words.zhGloss: 从每笔工资中存下一部分
words.enDefinition: To keep some of every wage payment as savings
acceptedZhAnswers: 从每笔工资中存下一部分

examples.en: I try to save part of each paycheck for the train fare home.
examples.zh: 我尽量「从每笔工资中存下一部分」，用来买回家的火车票。

examples.en: When she worked at the bookshop, Lena chose to save part of each paycheck.
examples.zh: 莉娜在书店工作时，选择「从每笔工资中存下一部分」。

collocations: save part of each paycheck for travel
manage to save part of each paycheck
consistently save part of each paycheck

words.enDefinition: A regular practice of setting money aside

examples.en: My weekend job helped me build a savings habit during my first year abroad.
examples.zh: 周末的兼职让我在出国第一年养成了「储蓄习惯」。

examples.en: It took time to get back into my savings habit after I changed jobs.
examples.zh: 换工作后，我花了一段时间才恢复原来的「储蓄习惯」。

words.enDefinition: Saving the difference when a purchase is rounded up

examples.en: The app labels the small amounts from my card purchases as round-up savings.
examples.zh: 应用把我刷卡时每笔金额向上取整产生的差额标为「支付进位储蓄」。

examples.en: I checked whether round-up savings were active before looking for the missing transfer.
examples.zh: 寻找那笔没看到的转账之前，我先查了「支付进位储蓄」是否已开启。

words.enDefinition: A separately labeled place in an app for savings

examples.en: I named my savings pot after the city I wanted to visit next summer.
examples.zh: 我用明年夏天想去的城市给我的「专项储蓄分区」命名。

examples.en: The app lets me move money between my savings pot and my main balance.
examples.zh: 这个应用可以让我在「专项储蓄分区」和主余额之间转账。

collocations: add money to a savings pot

words.enDefinition: To protect saved money for a specific purpose

examples.en: We decided to ring-fence savings for the trip before we started planning a party.
examples.zh: 开始筹备派对之前，我们决定把旅行那笔钱「专款留用」。

examples.en: The app gives me a way to ring-fence savings for my course without opening another account.
examples.zh: 这个应用让我可以把课程费用「专款留用」，不用再开一个账户。

words.enDefinition: To set aside money for a named purpose

examples.en: The student group agreed to earmark funds for travel before confirming its guest speakers.
examples.zh: 学生社团同意先「指定一笔资金用于差旅」，再确认受邀演讲嘉宾。

examples.en: I decided to earmark funds from my summer job for next year's language course.
examples.zh: 我决定把暑期打工的一笔收入「指定用于」明年的语言课程。

words.enDefinition: To put unexpected money into savings

examples.en: My sister decided to save a windfall she received when a utility company corrected an old bill.
examples.zh: 公用事业公司更正一张旧账单后，姐姐收到一笔退款，决定「把这笔意外所得存起来」。

examples.en: I decided to save a windfall from a writing contest for the trip home.
examples.zh: 我决定「存下写作比赛意外获得的奖金」，用在回家的路上。

words.enDefinition: To put bonus pay into savings

examples.en: Were you able to save a bonus from your holiday shifts for the train home?
examples.zh: 你把假期上班拿到的「奖金存下来」买回家的火车票了吗？

examples.en: I was able to save a bonus from work toward my university travel fund.
examples.zh: 我得以把工作发的「一笔奖金存入」大学期间的旅行基金。

words.enDefinition: A significant amount reached on the way to a target

examples.en: I reached my first savings milestone when the travel fund hit three hundred euros.
examples.zh: 旅行基金存到三百欧元时，我达成了第一个「阶段性储蓄目标」。

examples.en: The app sent a message when I passed a savings milestone on Friday.
examples.zh: 我周五达成一个「阶段性储蓄目标」时，应用发来了消息。

words.enDefinition: To omit a planned payment into savings

examples.en: I may have to skip a savings contribution while I wait for my wages.
examples.zh: 在等工资到账的这段时间里，我可能得「跳过一次储蓄存款」。

examples.en: The app asked whether I wanted to skip a savings contribution just this month.
examples.zh: 应用询问我是否只在这个月「跳过一次储蓄存款」。

collocations: choose to skip a savings contribution
need to skip a savings contribution
skip a savings contribution this month

words.enDefinition: The amount paid into savings on one occasion

examples.en: I changed the contribution amount after my weekly shifts went down from three to two.
examples.zh: 我每周上班的次数从三次减到两次后，就调整了「每次存入的金额」。

examples.en: Does the app show the contribution amount before I confirm the scheduled transfer?
examples.zh: 这个应用会在我确认定期转账前显示「每次存入的金额」吗？

words.enDefinition: A plan specifying when amounts are added

examples.en: The contribution schedule shows dates through the end of the summer holiday.
examples.zh: 「定期存入安排」列出了直到暑假结束的所有日期。

examples.en: Nico adjusted his contribution schedule so the transfer would follow his new payday.
examples.zh: 尼科调整了「定期存入安排」，让转账在他新的发薪日之后进行。

words.enDefinition: To add money beyond the planned amount

examples.en: I was able to make an extra contribution after I sold my old textbooks.
examples.zh: 我卖掉旧课本后，得以「额外存入一笔钱」。

examples.en: Does this account let me make an extra contribution separately from the monthly transfer?
examples.zh: 这个账户能让我在每月转账之外再「额外存入一笔钱」吗？

collocations: decide to make an extra contribution
make an extra contribution to savings
be able to make an extra contribution

words.enDefinition: Money left after paying immediate expenses

examples.en: I put any spare cash from weekend shifts into my travel fund last term.
examples.zh: 上学期我把周末打工赚来的「闲钱」都存进了旅行基金。

examples.en: My parents had a little spare cash after the move and used it for a holiday.
examples.zh: 我爸妈搬完家后还有一点「闲钱」，就拿去度假了。

words.enDefinition: To continue saving at the planned pace

examples.en: I used a calendar to stay on track with saving for my summer course.
examples.zh: 我用日历提醒自己「按计划继续为暑期课程存钱」。

examples.en: The extra shift helped me stay on track with saving during a quiet month.
examples.zh: 在工作不多的那个月，额外的一个班次帮我「按计划继续存钱」。

collocations: try to stay on track with saving
help someone stay on track with saving
stay on track with saving for a trip

words.enDefinition: To save less than planned by a point in time

examples.en: I began to fall behind on saving when the café reduced its opening hours.
examples.zh: 咖啡店缩短营业时间后，我的「储蓄进度开始落后」了。

examples.en: Did you fall behind on saving for the course during the exam period?
examples.zh: 考试期间，你为课程存钱的「进度落后」了吗？

collocations: start to fall behind on saving
fall behind on saving for college
fall behind on saving during a break

words.enDefinition: An increase in the amount held in savings

examples.en: The chart shows balance growth since I opened the account in September.
examples.zh: 这张图显示了我九月开户以来的「储蓄余额增长」情况。

examples.en: I could see the biggest balance growth in the months when I worked full-time.
examples.zh: 我看得出，全职工作的那几个月里，「储蓄余额增长」最明显。

words.enDefinition: A planned activity designed to encourage saving money

examples.en: Our residence hall ran a savings challenge during the first month of term.
examples.zh: 我们宿舍楼在学期第一个月开展了一项「储蓄挑战」。

examples.en: I joined a savings challenge with friends to see how much we could put away.
examples.zh: 我和朋友参加了一项「储蓄挑战」，看看大家能存下多少钱。

words.enDefinition: An unbroken run of regular savings contributions

examples.en: I kept my savings streak going through the last four weeks of term.
examples.zh: 学期最后四周，我保持了自己的「连续存钱纪录」。

examples.en: The app shows my savings streak beside the date of my last transfer.
examples.zh: 应用把我的「连续存钱纪录」显示在上次转账日期旁边。

words.enDefinition: To keep small leftover amounts as savings

examples.en: My uncle used to put spare change aside in a jar beside the door.
examples.zh: 我叔叔以前总会「把零钱存进」门边的一个罐子里。

examples.en: I still put spare change aside when I come home from the campus market.
examples.zh: 从校园集市回来时，我还是会「把零钱存起来」。

collocations: put spare change aside in a jar
put spare change aside for later

words.enDefinition: To contribute a corresponding amount toward your savings

examples.en: Will the student scheme match your savings if you put in money this term?
examples.zh: 如果你这学期存了钱，学生项目会「按比例补贴你的储蓄」吗？

examples.en: Tara asked whether the new programme would still match your savings after graduation.
examples.zh: 塔拉问，新项目在学生毕业后是否还会「按比例补贴储蓄」。

collocations: match your savings up to a limit
match your savings dollar for dollar

words.enDefinition: Money kept separately for a specified purpose

examples.en: Maya has dedicated savings for her language course and keeps them in a separate pot.
examples.zh: 玛雅把语言课程的费用作为「专项储蓄」，放在单独的储蓄分区里。

examples.en: I used a separate label in the app for my dedicated savings for language classes.
examples.zh: 我在应用里单独加了个标签，标明这笔是语言课的「专项储蓄」。

words.enDefinition: A labeled envelope for cash set aside

examples.en: I found a cash envelope marked travel at the back of my drawer.
examples.zh: 我在抽屉深处找到一个标着“旅行”的「装专用现金的信封」。

examples.en: My grandmother kept a cash envelope for the bus fares we needed as children.
examples.zh: 我们小时候需要坐公交车，奶奶专门留了一个「装车费现金的信封」。

collocations: put money in a cash envelope

words.enDefinition: Money set aside for unexpected urgent needs

examples.en: I used my emergency fund when I had to replace a broken laptop during finals.
examples.zh: 期末考试期间不得不换掉坏掉的笔记本时，我动用了「应急储备金」。

examples.en: She added to her emergency fund once her work hours returned to normal.
examples.zh: 工作时长恢复正常后，她又往「应急储备金」里存了些钱。

words.enDefinition: Extra readily available money for covering shortfalls

examples.en: My cash buffer covered the bills while I waited for my first paycheck.
examples.zh: 等第一笔工资到账期间，我用「现金缓冲储备」付了账单。

examples.en: I was glad to have a cash buffer when the café closed for repairs.
examples.zh: 咖啡店停业维修时，我庆幸自己有「现金缓冲储备」。

words.enDefinition: Physical cash kept available for urgent situations

examples.en: We took some emergency cash for the bus in case the card reader wasn't working.
examples.zh: 我们带了一点坐公交用的「应急现金」，以防刷卡机用不了。

examples.en: My aunt keeps emergency cash in the house for times when the power goes out.
examples.zh: 我姨妈在家留了点「应急现金」，以备停电时用。

words.enDefinition: A sudden event that significantly disrupts one's finances

examples.en: Losing most of my shifts in November was a financial shock I hadn't expected.
examples.zh: 十一月大部分班次都没了，这成了我没料到的「突发的财务冲击」。

examples.en: The car breakdown was a financial shock because we had just paid for the move.
examples.zh: 我们刚付完搬家费，车就坏了，带来了「突发的财务冲击」。

words.enDefinition: A period when regular earnings stop

examples.en: The income interruption lasted until the library reopened and I could take shifts again.
examples.zh: 这次「收入中断」持续到图书馆重新开放，我能再次排班为止。

examples.en: My notes show how much I drew from savings during the income interruption.
examples.zh: 记录显示了我在「收入中断」期间动用了多少存款。

words.enDefinition: A gap between available cash and amounts due

examples.en: A delay in my wages left me with a cash shortfall that Friday.
examples.zh: 那周五工资晚发，让我出现了「现金缺口」。

examples.en: We noticed a cash shortfall when the two refunds still hadn't arrived by Monday.
examples.zh: 到了周一，两笔退款依然没到账，我们发现出现了「现金缺口」。

words.enDefinition: A cost arising from an urgent situation

examples.en: The urgent flight home was the only emergency expense I had that term.
examples.zh: 紧急飞回家的机票，是我那学期唯一一笔「紧急开支」。

examples.en: I wrote down the emergency expense beside the amount I had left in savings.
examples.zh: 我在剩余存款金额旁记下了这笔「紧急开支」。

words.enDefinition: Costs of travel that must be arranged urgently

examples.en: There was enough in my travel pot to cover emergency travel expenses that weekend.
examples.zh: 那个周末，我的旅行储蓄分区里有足够的钱支付「紧急出行费用」。

examples.en: My family helped with emergency travel expenses after I had to fly home unexpectedly.
examples.zh: 我临时不得不飞回家，家里帮我承担了一部分「紧急出行费用」。

words.enDefinition: An event that puts someone's finances behind

examples.en: Losing the weekend job was a financial setback just before my first tuition payment.
examples.zh: 第一次缴学费前丢了周末的工作，是一次「财务挫折」。

examples.en: The repair bill was a financial setback, so I moved my savings deadline back a month.
examples.zh: 维修账单带来了一次「财务挫折」，于是我把存钱的期限推迟了一个月。

words.enDefinition: An urgent situation requiring money immediately

examples.en: I kept the reserve for a financial emergency while we waited for work to resume.
examples.zh: 等工作恢复的那段时间，我把这笔储备留着应对「紧急财务状况」。

examples.en: A family financial emergency meant I had to change my travel plans over the summer.
examples.zh: 家里出现「紧急财务状况」，我只好改变暑假的出行计划。

words.enDefinition: Money needed to cover an immediate cost

examples.en: I had a short-term cash need when my repair bill came just before payday.
examples.zh: 发工资前刚好收到维修账单，我有了「短期资金需求」。

examples.en: The bank asked whether I had a short-term cash need or could wait until June.
examples.zh: 银行问我是有「短期资金需求」，还是可以等到六月。

words.enDefinition: The original amount deposited before interest

examples.en: The bank listed the principal amount separately from the interest I had earned.
examples.zh: 银行把「本金金额」和我赚取的利息分开列出。

examples.en: I checked the principal amount on the confirmation against the transfer from my account.
examples.zh: 我核对了确认单上的「本金金额」和我账户的转账金额。

words.enDefinition: The amount someone aims to keep in reserve

examples.en: My reserve target changed after I moved closer to campus and cut my travel costs.
examples.zh: 搬到离学校更近的地方、交通费减少以后，我调了「储备金的目标金额」。

examples.en: The spreadsheet shows how far I am from the reserve target I set in September.
examples.zh: 电子表格显示了我距离九月设定的「储备金目标金额」还差多少。

words.enDefinition: To replace money spent from emergency savings

examples.en: It took me several months to replenish an emergency fund after the unexpected trip.
examples.zh: 那次临时出行后，我花了几个月才「补足应急金」。

examples.en: She used part of her tutoring money to replenish an emergency fund she'd drawn on.
examples.zh: 她拿出一部分辅导课收入，「补足了之前动用过的应急金」。

collocations: work to replenish an emergency fund
replenish an emergency fund after a withdrawal

words.enDefinition: To increase savings again after using them

examples.en: How long did it take to rebuild your savings after you moved to Bristol?
examples.zh: 搬到布里斯托尔后，您花了多久「重新攒起储蓄」？

examples.en: When did you begin to rebuild your savings after the repairs were finally paid for?
examples.zh: 终于付清维修费后，你什么时候开始「重新积攒储蓄」的？

collocations: take time to rebuild your savings
rebuild your savings after a move

words.enDefinition: To hold money back for later needs

examples.en: I prefer to keep money in reserve because my summer work hours are unpredictable.
examples.zh: 暑期工作时长不确定，所以我更愿意「留钱备用」。

examples.en: We agreed to keep money in reserve until the final moving bill arrived.
examples.zh: 我们说好先「留钱备用」，等搬家的最后一张账单寄来。

collocations: choose to keep money in reserve
keep money in reserve for repairs
keep money in reserve just in case

words.enDefinition: To use some savings to cover a cost

examples.en: I had to dip into savings when my bike needed a new wheel.
examples.zh: 自行车得换轮子时，我不得不「动用少量储蓄」。

examples.en: Mina hoped she wouldn't need to dip into savings for the textbooks this term.
examples.zh: 米娜希望这学期买教材时不用「动用少量储蓄」。

collocations: avoid having to dip into savings

words.enDefinition: To reduce savings by using them over time

examples.en: I had to draw down savings while I looked for another job near campus.
examples.zh: 在学校附近找下一份工作的那段时间，我不得不「逐步消耗储蓄」。

examples.en: We began to draw down savings as the break between placements grew longer.
examples.zh: 两段实习之间的空档越来越长，我们开始「逐步消耗储蓄」。

collocations: draw down savings over several months
draw down savings during a period without work

words.enDefinition: To spend all the money that was saved

examples.en: I didn't want to use up savings before my summer job started in June.
examples.zh: 我不想在六月暑期工作开始之前就「用光储蓄」。

examples.en: The family worried they might use up savings if the repairs took another month.
examples.zh: 家里担心维修要是再拖一个月，可能会「用光储蓄」。

collocations: avoid having to use up savings
use up savings on living costs

words.enDefinition: To keep saved money without spending any of it

examples.en: I managed to leave savings untouched while waiting for the money from my last shift.
examples.zh: 等上一个班次的工资时，我设法「没动用储蓄」。

examples.en: We could leave savings untouched once the landlord agreed to cover the repair bill.
examples.zh: 房东同意承担维修费后，我们就可以「不动用储蓄」了。

collocations: leave savings untouched for another month

words.enDefinition: The amount currently held in savings

examples.en: I checked my savings balance before deciding whether to book the train that night.
examples.zh: 那天晚上决定要不要订票之前，我先查了「储蓄余额」。

examples.en: The interest payment increased my savings balance by a few euros in October.
examples.zh: 十月份的利息入账让我的「储蓄余额」增加了几欧元。

words.enDefinition: A payment taken out of savings

examples.en: My statement shows a savings withdrawal on the day I paid for the repair.
examples.zh: 我的账单显示，我支付维修费的那天有一笔「提取储蓄款」的记录。

examples.en: I kept the receipt from the savings withdrawal in case the date was disputed.
examples.zh: 我留着那笔「支取储蓄款」的凭据，以防有人对日期有疑问。

words.enDefinition: A formal instruction asking to take money out

examples.en: The bank sent me an email after it received the withdrawal request on Tuesday.
examples.zh: 银行周二收到「提款申请」后给我发了邮件。

examples.en: I checked the amount on my withdrawal request before sending the form to the bank.
examples.zh: 把表格发给银行之前，我核对了「提款申请」上的金额。

words.enDefinition: A message confirming a withdrawal has been completed

examples.en: I filed the withdrawal confirmation with the statement I downloaded from the bank.
examples.zh: 我把「提款确认通知」和从银行下载的账单存放在一起。

examples.en: The withdrawal confirmation showed the exact amount that had been sent on Friday.
examples.zh: 「提款确认通知」显示了周五汇出的确切金额。

words.enDefinition: Advance notice of an intended withdrawal

examples.en: The bank recorded my withdrawal notice on the same day I submitted it online.
examples.zh: 银行在我在线提交的当天登记了我的「提款提前通知」。

examples.en: The email showed the date my withdrawal notice would take effect later that month.
examples.zh: 邮件列出了我的「提款提前通知」当月晚些时候将生效的日期。

words.enDefinition: A limited period during which withdrawals can be made

examples.en: The letter gave the dates of the withdrawal window for my maturing deposit.
examples.zh: 信里列明了我这笔即将到期的存款的「可提款时间段」。

examples.en: I called because the withdrawal window on the app didn't match the letter.
examples.zh: 应用里显示的「可提款时间段」和信上不一致，所以我打了电话。

words.enDefinition: Rules specifying when and how money may be withdrawn

examples.en: I read the withdrawal conditions when I opened the updated document from the bank.
examples.zh: 我打开银行更新后的文件，读了里面的「提款条件」。

examples.en: The representative explained the withdrawal conditions using the date printed on my confirmation letter.
examples.zh: 客服参照确认信上印的日期，向我解释了「提款条件」。

words.enDefinition: Taking money out before a specified date

examples.en: The bank's letter said that an early withdrawal was possible on this particular deposit.
examples.zh: 银行的信说，这一笔存款可以「提前支取」。

examples.en: Did the app show your early withdrawal separately from your scheduled interest payment?
examples.zh: 应用有把你的「提前支取」和定期支付的利息分开显示吗？

collocations: an early withdrawal from a term deposit

words.enDefinition: A charge for taking money out before the agreed date

examples.en: The statement showed an early withdrawal penalty beside the amount returned to my account.
examples.zh: 账单在退回我账户的金额旁标出了「提前支取罚款」。

examples.en: I asked whether the early withdrawal penalty shown in the example applied to my deposit.
examples.zh: 我问示例展示的「提前支取罚款」是否适用于我的存款。

words.enDefinition: Taking money out without a withdrawal penalty

examples.en: The bank sent a reminder about the last day for a penalty-free withdrawal.
examples.zh: 银行发来提醒，告知可以「免罚款支取」的最后一天。

examples.en: The clerk explained why a penalty-free withdrawal appeared as a separate option in my account.
examples.zh: 工作人员解释了为什么我的账户会把「免罚款支取」单独列为一项。

words.enDefinition: Taking out some of a balance, leaving the rest

examples.en: I requested a partial withdrawal and left the rest of the money on deposit.
examples.zh: 我申请了「部分支取」，把剩余的钱继续存着。

examples.en: The letter showed how much would remain after the partial withdrawal was processed.
examples.zh: 信上写明了「部分支取」办妥后还会剩下多少。

words.enDefinition: Able to be taken out now

examples.en: The app showed ninety pounds available for withdrawal when I checked my savings balance.
examples.zh: 我查储蓄余额时，应用显示有九十英镑「可供提取」。

examples.en: I asked when the full balance would be available for withdrawal after the deposit matured.
examples.zh: 我问这笔存款到期后，全部余额什么时候「可供提取」。

words.enDefinition: Savings that can be accessed readily

examples.en: My spreadsheet lists liquid savings separately from money I have committed for a year.
examples.zh: 我的电子表格把「易于动用的储蓄」和锁定一年的资金分开列了。

examples.en: I used part of my liquid savings when I needed to pay for a repair quickly.
examples.zh: 需要马上支付维修费时，我动用了一部分「易于动用的储蓄」。

words.enDefinition: Money that cannot normally be accessed before a date

examples.en: The app showed my locked-in funds in a separate section of the account summary.
examples.zh: 应用把我的「锁定资金」单独列在账户概览的一个栏目里。

examples.en: I asked which day the locked-in funds would become accessible under the deposit agreement.
examples.zh: 我问按照存款协议，这笔「锁定资金」哪天可以动用。

words.enDefinition: An amount measured by how many months of expenses it covers

examples.en: Their savings covered two months of expenses during the break between university jobs.
examples.zh: 两份校内工作交替的空档里，他们的存款够付「两个月的开支」。

examples.en: I wrote down how many months of expenses my current savings could cover.
examples.zh: 我记下现有的储蓄够付「几个月的开支」。

collocations: enough for three months of expenses

words.expression: cash in a certificate of deposit
words.lemma: cash in a certificate of deposit
words.enDefinition: To redeem a certificate of deposit for its funds
acceptedEnVariants: cash in a certificate of deposit

examples.en: I asked what documents I needed to cash in a certificate of deposit at the branch.
examples.zh: 我问去银行网点「兑现定期存单」需要哪些文件。

examples.en: Can I cash in a certificate of deposit online if it has already matured?
examples.zh: 如果已经到期，我可以在线「兑现定期存单」吗？

collocations: cash in a certificate of deposit early
cash in a certificate of deposit at maturity
choose to cash in a certificate of deposit

words.enDefinition: To be able to use money one has saved

examples.en: How quickly could you access your savings when you needed a replacement phone?
examples.zh: 需要换手机时，你多久能「取用积蓄」？

examples.en: Can you access your savings through the app if you're away from campus?
examples.zh: 不在学校时，你能通过应用「取用储蓄」吗？

collocations: be able to access your savings

words.enDefinition: The sum taken out of an account

examples.en: The withdrawal amount on the receipt matched the number I entered on the form.
examples.zh: 凭据上的「支取金额」和我在表格里填的数字一致。

examples.en: I changed the withdrawal amount after checking how much the replacement ticket would cost.
examples.zh: 确认了补买车票的费用后，我改了「支取金额」。

words.enDefinition: A rule limiting when or how funds can be withdrawn

examples.en: The bank's leaflet explained the withdrawal restriction that applied during the first month.
examples.zh: 银行的传单说明了第一个月适用的「提款限制」。

examples.en: I checked whether the withdrawal restriction applied to the full balance or only part of it.
examples.zh: 我查了这项「提款限制」适用于全部余额还是只适用于其中一部分。

words.enDefinition: Money available to spend immediately

examples.en: The extra money on hand meant we could book a different train after ours was cancelled.
examples.zh: 原先的列车取消后，靠「手头多出来的资金」，我们可以改订另一趟车。

examples.en: There was enough money on hand to pay the plumber before my wages arrived.
examples.zh: 工资到账之前，我「手头有足够的钱」付水管工的费用。

words.enDefinition: Money a deposit has generated as interest

examples.en: The statement lists the interest earned since I opened the account in March.
examples.zh: 账单列出了我三月开户以来「已赚取的利息」。

examples.en: Can I see the interest earned so far without downloading the monthly statement?
examples.zh: 我能不下载月结单就看到目前「已赚取的利息」吗？

words.enDefinition: An amount added to an account as interest

examples.en: The interest credit was listed just below my regular transfer on the statement.
examples.zh: 账单把「利息入账款项」列在我的定期转账记录下方。

examples.en: I noticed a small interest credit after checking the balance on my phone.
examples.zh: 用手机查余额时，我注意到一笔金额很小的「利息入账款项」。

words.enDefinition: The buildup of interest over time

examples.en: I asked whether interest accrual began on the day the deposit was funded.
examples.zh: 我问「利息累积」是不是从存款到账那天开始。

examples.en: The change didn't affect interest accrual for the period shown on this statement.
examples.zh: 这次变动没有影响账单所列期间的「利息累积」。

words.enDefinition: To gain interest on money held on deposit

examples.en: The representative showed me which deposits could earn interest at the advertised rate.
examples.zh: 银行人员给我看了哪些存款可以按宣传利率「获得利息收益」。

examples.en: I wondered whether my account would still earn interest after the promotional period ended.
examples.zh: 我想知道优惠期结束后，我的账户是否还能「获得利息收益」。

collocations: earn interest from the first day

words.enDefinition: To build up interest over time

examples.en: My deposit began to accrue interest before the first payment appeared on my statement.
examples.zh: 账单出现第一笔利息入账前，我的存款就开始「累积利息」了。

examples.en: Does the balance still accrue interest while the bank processes my withdrawal request?
examples.zh: 银行处理提款申请时，这笔余额是否仍会「累积利息」？

words.enDefinition: An interest rate quoted for a year

examples.en: The annual interest rate is printed next to the term on my deposit confirmation.
examples.zh: 我的存款确认单把「年利率」印在存期旁边。

examples.en: I couldn't find the annual interest rate on the first screen of the app.
examples.zh: 我在应用的第一个页面找不到「年利率」。

words.enDefinition: A U.S. annual deposit yield reflecting compound interest

examples.en: The U.S. bank advertised an annual percentage yield beside the headline interest rate.
examples.zh: 这家美国银行把「年收益率」标在宣传利率旁边。

examples.en: The comparison page showed the annual percentage yield for each account at that bank.
examples.zh: 这家银行各款账户的「年收益率」都列在对比页上。

words.enDefinition: A UK annual savings rate reflecting compound interest

examples.en: The British bank included the annual equivalent rate in its comparison table for savers.
examples.zh: 这家英国银行在给储户看的对比表里列出了「年等效利率」。

examples.en: The account summary lists the annual equivalent rate beside the gross interest rate.
examples.zh: 账户概览把「年等效利率」列在税前利率旁边。

words.enDefinition: A promotional rate offered for an initial period

examples.en: My bank showed the end date of the introductory rate in the welcome email.
examples.zh: 银行在欢迎邮件里写明了「新户限期优惠利率」的截止日期。

examples.en: Does the introductory rate last until the end of the calendar month in this offer?
examples.zh: 这项优惠的「新户限期优惠利率」会持续到当月月底吗？

words.enDefinition: Extra interest paid when specified conditions are met

examples.en: The statement shows the bonus interest separately from the usual interest for that month.
examples.zh: 这份账单把当月的「额外奖励利息」和普通利息分开列了。

examples.en: I asked why the bonus interest on my account was different in February.
examples.zh: 我问为什么二月账户中的「额外奖励利息」金额不一样。

words.enDefinition: A rate paid before any promotional additions

examples.en: The leaflet showed the base interest rate beside the rate with the monthly bonus.
examples.zh: 传单把「基础利率」和含月度奖励的利率并排列出。

examples.en: I called the bank to check whether the base interest rate had changed in June.
examples.zh: 我打电话问银行六月的「基础利率」有没有调整。

collocations: a change to the base interest rate

words.enDefinition: A savings interest rate that stays the same

examples.en: The letter confirmed a fixed savings rate for the full term of my deposit.
examples.zh: 信里确认，我这笔存款在整个存期内采用「固定储蓄利率」。

examples.en: The product page put the fixed savings rate below the name of the account.
examples.zh: 产品页面把「固定储蓄利率」放在账户名称下方。

collocations: a fixed savings rate for the full term

words.enDefinition: A savings interest rate that can change

examples.en: The welcome pack says the account has a variable savings rate that may change.
examples.zh: 开户资料写明，该账户采用可能调整的「浮动储蓄利率」。

examples.en: I checked the date when the new variable savings rate would start to apply.
examples.zh: 我查了新的「浮动储蓄利率」从哪天起适用。

collocations: a change to a variable savings rate

words.enDefinition: A message announcing a change in an interest rate

examples.en: The rate change notice showed when the new rate would apply to my savings.
examples.zh: 「利率变动通知」写明了我的存款何时开始适用新利率。

examples.en: I saved the rate change notice in the same folder as my welcome letter.
examples.zh: 我把「利率变动通知」和欢迎信保存在同一个文件夹里。

words.enDefinition: A document detailing interest paid or earned

examples.en: I downloaded an interest statement so I could see the total for the year.
examples.zh: 我下载了「利息明细单」，想查看全年的利息总额。

examples.en: The date on the interest statement matched the end of the previous calendar year.
examples.zh: 「利息明细单」上的日期是上一年的年末。

words.enDefinition: Calculation of interest separately for each day

examples.en: The representative explained the daily interest calculation using the balance shown on my first statement.
examples.zh: 银行工作人员用我第一份账单上的余额，解释了「按日计息」的方式。

examples.en: I checked the daily interest calculation against the example in the savings account guide.
examples.zh: 我对照储蓄账户指南里的示例核对了「按日计息」的方法。

collocations: the basis for daily interest calculation

words.enDefinition: Interest paid once a month

examples.en: I noticed the monthly interest payment had arrived before my regular savings transfer.
examples.zh: 我看到「每月利息款项」在我那笔定期储蓄转账前就到账了。

examples.en: The statement lists the monthly interest payment on the last day of each month.
examples.zh: 账单把「每月利息款项」列在每个月的最后一天。

words.enDefinition: How often a deposit's interest is paid

examples.en: The form showed the interest payment frequency next to the interest rate for each product.
examples.zh: 表格在每款产品的利率旁边注明了「利息支付频率」。

examples.en: I asked whether the interest payment frequency could be changed after the account opened.
examples.zh: 我问开立账户以后能否更改「利息支付频率」。

words.enDefinition: Interest before any tax is deducted

examples.en: My statement showed the gross interest separately from the amount that reached my account.
examples.zh: 账单把「税前利息」和实际到账金额分开列了。

examples.en: I located the gross interest for the year in the bank's annual summary.
examples.zh: 我在银行的年度摘要里找到了这一年的「税前利息」。

words.enDefinition: Interest remaining after tax is deducted

examples.en: I compared the net interest on my statement with the amount I actually received.
examples.zh: 我比较了账单上的「税后利息」和实际收到的金额。

examples.en: The report listed net interest in the column next to the amount withheld.
examples.zh: 报告把「税后利息」列在预扣金额的旁边一栏。

words.enDefinition: To add interest earned back into the deposit

examples.en: The form asked whether I wanted to reinvest interest when the deposit was renewed.
examples.zh: 表格问我续存时是否想「把利息继续存入」。

examples.en: The app offered a choice to reinvest interest or have it paid separately.
examples.zh: 应用提供了两个选项，可以「把利息继续存入」，也可以把它单独划出。

words.enDefinition: To take out interest earned while leaving the deposit

examples.en: The bank confirmed I could withdraw interest separately under the terms of this product.
examples.zh: 银行确认，按这款产品的条款，我可以单独「提取利息」。

examples.en: I asked when I could withdraw interest without closing my savings account entirely.
examples.zh: 我问什么时候可以「提取利息」，同时保留储蓄账户。

words.enDefinition: The balance that meets a stated requirement

examples.en: The app listed the qualifying balance used to work out my bonus interest.
examples.zh: 应用列出了计算奖励利息所依据的「符合条件的账户余额」。

examples.en: I asked what counted toward the qualifying balance for the new savings offer.
examples.zh: 我问这项新储蓄优惠里，哪些钱计入「符合条件的账户余额」。

words.enDefinition: a payment of interest to the depositor, which may be paid out separately from the deposit

examples.en: I chose to have the interest payout sent to my current account in May.
examples.zh: 我选择让五月「支付的利息」转入我的活期账户。

examples.en: The bank's email showed the interest payout for the three months before I closed the account.
examples.zh: 银行邮件列出了我销户前三个月「支付的利息」。

words.enDefinition: The agreed length of time for a deposit

examples.en: The confirmation gives the deposit term in months and the final date in full.
examples.zh: 确认单注明了以月为单位的「存款期限」和完整的到期日期。

examples.en: The form let me select a deposit term from several options listed down the page.
examples.zh: 表格在页面上列出几个选项，让我选择「存款期限」。

collocations: the end of the deposit term

words.enDefinition: A message stating that a deposit is nearing maturity

examples.en: The maturity notice reached my inbox two weeks before the end of the term.
examples.zh: 距离存期结束还有两周时，我的邮箱收到了「存款到期通知」。

examples.en: I checked the maturity notice again to find the bank's number before calling.
examples.zh: 打电话前，我重新看了「存款到期通知」，找到了银行的号码。

words.enDefinition: Instructions for handling a deposit when its term ends

examples.en: I entered my maturity instructions after confirming where the money would be sent.
examples.zh: 确认钱将转到哪里后，我填写了「存款到期处理指示」。

examples.en: The bank asked me to review the maturity instructions one week before the term ended.
examples.zh: 银行让我在存期结束前一周核对「存款到期处理指示」。

words.enDefinition: The money payable when a deposit matures

examples.en: The letter said the maturity proceeds would go into the account I'd specified.
examples.zh: 信上说，「存款到期所得款项」会转入我指定的账户。

examples.en: The maturity proceeds on my statement matched the figure in the bank's letter.
examples.zh: 账单上的「存款到期所得款项」和银行信中列出的数字一致。

words.enDefinition: To come to the end of an agreed deposit term

examples.en: The letter said my deposit would reach maturity on the tenth of next month.
examples.zh: 信上说，我的存款将在下个月十日「到期」。

examples.en: Did your deposit reach maturity before you moved to a different city last year?
examples.zh: 你去年搬去另一个城市之前，那笔存款已经「到期」了吗？

collocations: reach maturity at the end of the term

words.enDefinition: To continue a term deposit for another agreed period

examples.en: The bank's email explained how to renew a term deposit through the online account.
examples.zh: 银行在邮件中说明了如何用网上账户「续存一笔定期存款」。

examples.en: I called because I couldn't find the option to renew a term deposit online.
examples.zh: 我在线上找不到「续存定期存款」的选项，就打了电话。

collocations: choose to renew a term deposit

words.enDefinition: Renewal of a deposit without a new instruction

examples.en: The form showed whether automatic rollover was selected for the end of my deposit term.
examples.zh: 表格显示了我是否选择在存期结束时「自动转存」。

examples.en: The bank's letter said the automatic rollover would be shown in the next statement.
examples.zh: 银行的信说，下一份账单会显示这笔「自动转存」。

words.enDefinition: The interest rate offered for a renewed deposit

examples.en: The letter listed a renewal rate for each new term the bank was offering.
examples.zh: 银行为信中提供的每种新存期都列了一个「续存利率」。

examples.en: I checked whether the renewal rate in the email matched the one on the app.
examples.zh: 我核对了邮件中的「续存利率」和应用里显示的是否一致。

words.enDefinition: To take out money when the deposit term ends

examples.en: The confirmation says I chose to withdraw at maturity when I opened the deposit.
examples.zh: 确认单显示，我办理这笔存款时选择了「到期支取」。

examples.en: I asked whether I could withdraw at maturity using the bank's app while travelling.
examples.zh: 我问旅行途中能不能用银行的应用「到期支取」。

collocations: be able to withdraw at maturity
withdraw at maturity without a charge

words.enDefinition: A record acknowledging the terms and amount deposited

examples.en: The deposit confirmation arrived by email after the bank received my initial payment.
examples.zh: 银行收到我最先存入的钱后，通过邮件发来了「存款确认单」。

examples.en: I checked the spelling of my name on the deposit confirmation before saving the file.
examples.zh: 保存文件前，我核对了「存款确认单」上自己名字的拼写。

collocations: the reference on the deposit confirmation

words.enDefinition: Arrangements protecting eligible deposits if a bank fails

examples.en: The bank's leaflet explained which accounts were covered by deposit protection in that country.
examples.zh: 银行的传单说明了哪些账户受当地「存款保障」制度保护。

examples.en: The eligibility notes mention deposit protection near the end of the product information sheet.
examples.zh: 产品资料末尾的资格说明提到了「存款保障」。

words.enDefinition: The maximum amount covered by a protection scheme

examples.en: The information sheet lists the deposit protection limit next to the scheme's contact details.
examples.zh: 资料页在保障计划的联系方式旁列出了「存款保障上限」。

examples.en: I checked which deposit protection limit the leaflet referred to after reading the account summary.
examples.zh: 读完账户概览后，我核实了传单里指的是哪项「存款保障上限」。

words.enDefinition: A deposit covered by a deposit insurance scheme

examples.en: The brochure gives an example showing how an insured deposit appears in the summary.
examples.zh: 宣传册用一个例子展示了「受保险保障的存款」在摘要里是怎么显示的。

examples.en: The student adviser explained why the two brochures used different wording for an insured deposit.
examples.zh: 学生顾问解释了两份宣传册为何对「受保险保障的存款」使用不同表述。

collocations: the balance of an insured deposit

words.enDefinition: Deposits that meet a protection scheme's requirements

examples.en: The protection leaflet lists eligible deposits in a table beside the main exclusions.
examples.zh: 保障传单在主要除外项目旁边用表格列出「符合保障条件的存款」。

examples.en: I asked the bank where I could find the official list of eligible deposits.
examples.zh: 我问银行在哪里能找到「符合保障条件的存款」的正式清单。

collocations: cover eligible deposits up to a limit

words.enDefinition: A bank's closure after it becomes unable to operate

examples.en: The leaflet described how the scheme handles savings in the event of a bank failure.
examples.zh: 传单说明了发生「银行倒闭」时，该计划如何处理储蓄款。

examples.en: I asked the adviser what would happen to my deposit after a bank failure.
examples.zh: 我问顾问，如果「银行倒闭」，我的存款会怎么样。

collocations: in the event of a bank failure
the aftermath of a bank failure

words.enDefinition: Savings the owner or beneficiary has not claimed

examples.en: The site listed the contact details for people asking about unclaimed savings from former accounts.
examples.zh: 网站列出了供人们查询旧账户中「无人认领的储蓄款」的联系方式。

examples.en: My father found an old statement while looking into unclaimed savings from his student days.
examples.zh: 爸爸在查询学生时代的「无人认领的储蓄款」时找到了一份旧账单。

words.enDefinition: How much a given amount of money can buy

examples.en: The article explained how rising prices affected the purchasing power of my savings.
examples.zh: 文章解释了物价上涨会怎样影响我的储蓄的「购买力」。

examples.en: I noticed that the purchasing power of my travel fund had fallen since last summer.
examples.zh: 我发现，与去年夏天相比，我的旅行基金「购买力」下降了。
